text.en: Most dog owners praise individual trainers such as Andy and Grace for their patience, clear guidance, and dedicated support. Clients appreciate that trainers take time to answer questions and conduct thorough owner handover lessons. In contrast, one critical reviewer reported an aggressive and unhelpful interaction with management regarding a disputed placement.

Clients frequently report noticeable progress in canine obedience, leash manners, and focus after completing training programs. Pet parents highlight how instruction helped manage reactivity and establish reliable commands. However, one client experienced severe issues with a placed protection dog that exhibited household aggression and bitten another family pet.

Several reviewers appreciate receiving regular video updates demonstrating their dog's training progress and clear explanations from trainers. Front desk staff are generally described as responsive during business hours. Conversely, a dissatisfied client cited changing promises, unexpected boarding charges, and disputed quotes during a contentious service agreement.

q.en: Do owners receive video progress reports during training?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight receiving weekly video recordings showing the commands and skills their dog is mastering.

q.en: Are owner transition sessions included with training?

a.en: Yes, reviewers describe participating in in-person integration sessions so handlers learn the commands before taking dogs home.

q.en: What types of training programs are offered?

a.en: The academy provides board-and-train programs, puppy foundational lessons, and behavior modification for reactive dogs.

q.en: Is there an additional fee for credit card payments?

a.en: Yes, a reviewer mentions a four percent surcharge applied when paying with a credit card instead of direct payment options.
